description: This file defines strategies for pointwise tensor operations in PyTorch's distributed tensor framework, including registration of strategies for various pointwise and fused operations, handling broadcasting, partial placements, and linearity support.

classes.name: OpStrategy
classes.description: Represents a strategy for tensor operation placement and sharding.

classes.name: OpSpec
classes.description: Specifies a particular operation strategy, including input/output tensor specs and redistribution costs.

classes.name: RuntimeSchemaInfo
classes.description: Holds runtime schema information for operation strategy registration.

classes.name: TupleStrategy
classes.description: A strategy composed of multiple child strategies, typically for list or tuple inputs.

methods.name: pointwise_strategy
methods.description: Generates a strategy for a pointwise operation, following the operand with the most shards or a specified strategy.

methods.name: linear_pointwise_strategy
methods.description: Creates a strategy for linear pointwise operators that support propagation of pending reductions.

methods.name: partial_preserving_pointwise_strategy
methods.description: Creates a strategy for pointwise ops that preserve specific Partial placements.

methods.name: single_mesh_dim_pointwise_strategy
methods.description: Generates a strategy for pointwise ops constrained to a single device mesh dimension.

methods.name: single_mesh_dim_linear_pointwise_strategy
methods.description: Returns a partial function for single-mesh-dimension linear pointwise strategies.

methods.name: common_pointwise_strategy
methods.description: Core logic for generating pointwise operation strategies, handling broadcasting, partial placements, and linearity.

methods.name: list_pointwise_strategy
methods.description: Applies pointwise strategies to list or tuple inputs, supporting broadcasting and list strategies.

methods.name: list_linear_pointwise_strategy
methods.description: Applies list pointwise strategy supporting linearity.

methods.name: register_op_strategy
methods.description: Registers a strategy function for a specific operation overload.
